videos.title: Pyramid-CORE
videos.description:
Helloo! I made a short version of this beat a while ago and I decided to finish it recently, It took me a while and my pc could literally not run if I didn't consolidate a few tracks!! Also it was a good opportunity to practice my guitar skills (which are lacking)!

Listen to it on spotify here!!

https://open.spotify.com/album/2k38h7XX9QM5SGPKo6Kfzl?si=ei9-pLFvTMyKhTUcXebenQ
